<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 183.0451. Assuming it is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈182.0378 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass, while also being consistent with the observed ~10 % M+1 intensity (suggesting ~8–9 carbons), is C₈H₆O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H6O5</final_answer>
